case.brief: The big bag of marshmallows for tonight's campfire vanished from the Red cabin porch. No marshmallows means no s'mores! Who took them?

herrings.absent: So Priya skipped swim. But where did the marshmallows go?
herrings.priyasays: That's what Priya says. Does anything show otherwise?
herrings.raccoon: The raccoon only found banana peels. Keep looking!

hints: Someone wasn't where they said they were.
Marshmallows are sticky. Check the lost and found.

clue.d: Says she was at swim lessons.

people.name: Priya
people.says: I was at swim lessons all afternoon!

people.name: Coach Dana
people.says: I saw the marshmallow bag on the porch at three o'clock, safe and sound.

people.name: Jonah
people.says: I was at swim the whole time. Priya wasn't there, though.

places.name: Red cabin
places.text: The marshmallows sat on the porch by the door. Now there are only a few powdery crumbs.

clue.d: A raccoon visited, but only found banana peels.

places.name: Paw prints
places.text: Raccoon tracks lead to the trash can, but the can only has banana peels inside.

places.name: Swim sign-in
places.text: Swim lesson, 3 to 4 pm. Jonah ✓. Priya: absent.

clue.d: Priya's sweatshirt pocket is full of marshmallow fluff.

places.name: Lost & found
places.text: A red sweatshirt labeled PRIYA. The pocket is sticky with marshmallow fluff!

places.name: Flagpole
places.text: The camp flag flaps in the breeze. No marshmallows up there.

retorts: It wasn't me! Look at the clues again.
Hmm, that clue doesn't prove it. Try another one!
case.title: The Marshmallow Mystery
case.wrap: Priya skipped swim because she was nervous about the deep end, and snacked on marshmallows instead. Coach Dana found her a swim buddy, and the whole camp shared the last bag at the campfire.
